verdict.rationale: Statsig ships its own official MCP server that lets users talk to their Statsig projects in natural language from ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor and Claude Code. The documented use is reading: asking questions, exploring experiments and accessing data. It also depends on a third-party AI client rather than an in-product natural-language interface. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can perform write operations (create, update or roll out gates and experiments), a native in-console natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
Admins can configure Claude's connection to Statsig centrally instead of asking each member to authenticate.
